name: GiveDirectly, Inc
mission:
GiveDirectly is a nonprofit that lets donors send money directly to the world’s poorest households. We believe people living in poverty deserve the dignity to choose for themselves how best to improve their lives — cash enables that choice.

Since 2009, we’ve delivered $700M+ in cash directly into the hands of over 1.5 million people living in poverty. We currently have operations in Bangladesh, DRC, Kenya, Liberia, Malawi, Mozambique, Morocco, Nigeria, Rwanda, Turkey, Uganda, USA, and Yemen.
theoryOfChange: Giving cash shifts power to the person living in poverty, recognizing they are the expert in their own lives and granting them the dignity to choose for themselves. Research finds they spend cash aid in impactful and creative ways.

strengths.detail: GiveDirectly maintained an <cite id="[3]">87.1% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, ensuring the vast majority of funds reach beneficiaries directly [3].
The organization operates efficiently with a fundraising efficiency rate of <cite id="[1]">$0.04 spent to raise $1</cite> [1].

strengths_deep_dive: GiveDirectly's direct service delivery achieves significant cost efficiency. With a <cite id="[3]">Program expense ratio of 87.1% in FY2024</cite>, the charity allocates funds effectively into field operations [3]. This beats the 75% industry benchmark, though it remains slightly below the peer median of 88.7% for international humanitarian organizations. The model relies on rigorous operational logistics and digital transfers to reach families across Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Rwanda, and Uganda [5]. Furthermore, Charity Navigator rates GiveDirectly with an <cite id="[1]">overall score of 94/100</cite>, supported by strong fundraising efficiency where it incurs <cite id="[1]">just $0.04 in costs for every dollar raised</cite> [1].
rich_narrative.summary: GiveDirectly operates a direct cash transfer model to reduce global poverty by sending funds straight to individuals living in extreme poverty [5]. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="[3]">Total Revenue of $206,811,067</cite>, demonstrating significant operational scale [3]. The charity maintains a strong financial track record, directing <cite id="[3]">91.8% of its expenses to program services</cite> in FY2024, which exceeds the standard industry benchmark of 75% [3]. External evaluators recognize its performance, evidenced by a <cite id="[1]">94/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> [1]. Operations focus primarily on households across Africa, including Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Rwanda, and Uganda [5]. By giving cash directly, GiveDirectly allows recipients to address their own immediate priorities efficiently.
